أقترح (form VIII)
# أَقْتَرِحُ (ʔaqtariḥu) /ʔaq.ta.ri.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# أُقْتَرَحُ (ʔuqtaraḥu) /ʔuq.ta.ra.ħu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# أَقْتَرِحَ (ʔaqtariḥa) /ʔaq.ta.ri.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# أُقْتَرَحَ (ʔuqtaraḥa) /ʔuq.ta.ra
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
